verifiedVersions.document: LPFP consolidated regulation with amendments through 28 June 2012

format.firstStage: All tier-2 first teams excluding B teams; four groups, each top two advances; variable allocation according to 12–22 eligible clubs (22-club table appears to contain a repeated E4, not repaired).
format.secondStage: 8 qualifiers + previous top-flight positions 9–14 + two promoted clubs; eight two-leg ties, prior-stage qualifiers home first.
format.thirdStage: 8 winners plus previous top-flight positions 1–8; four groups of four, single round robin, group winners advance.

tieBreak.twoLeg: Equal aggregate goals directly to penalties; no away-goal criterion in art7.3.
tieBreak.age: Sum full-year ages of players actually used per match, divide by sum of player appearances across phase. Repeat appearances counted again; not whole squad or minutes-weighted. No further equal-age fallback specified in extracted provision.
